newsitem.title: SWEDEN: AGA in gas recovery deal with U.S. Enerfex.
newsitem.headline: AGA in gas recovery deal with U.S. Enerfex.

text.p: Swedish medical and industrial gas company AGA AB said on Thursday it had entered an agreement with U.S. company Enerfex Inc. to jointly develop and commercialise a new patented technology for the recovery of carbon dioxide from flue gases.
AGA said in a statement that the agreement included an option for AGA to acquire the patents and know-how from Enerfex, a research and development company based in Williston, Vermont.
"This is a continuation of our strategy to develop on-site gas supply solutions for our customers," said AGA spokesman Torsten Granberg in the statement.
The technology allows for process industries to recover carbon dioxide with less impact on the environment, AGA said.
